title: Inside Maybelline’s third summer in the ‘Love Island’ villa
summary: At the Glossy Beauty & Wellness Summit, Maybelline and Essie USA president Yasmin Dastmalchi explained why she banned the word “sponsorship” and how her team built a lip gloss launch into “Love Island USA.”
